reference: SDET in Kannada – Learn Test Automation in Kannada.html

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: The landing page introduces the Kannada SDET learning site and links to its courses, interview section, jobs, and community.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Open index.html and follow each navigation link.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Visitors can browse six courses, search course names and lesson text, filter by level and status, expand lessons, star courses, and mark lessons complete.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Use the course search, filters, star buttons, and lesson checkboxes.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Course progress and starred courses persist in the browser on the same device.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Change course progress, reload the page, and confirm the state remains.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Visitors can search interview questions and filter them by topic.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Search and select each interview topic filter.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: The site supports Kannada and English interface content and light/dark themes.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Use the language and theme controls.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: The page is responsive and usable on mobile and desktop.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Review the page at narrow and wide viewport sizes.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: A learner can resume the next unfinished course, and the site offers install/offline support where the browser supports progressive web apps.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Use the resume control; install the app in a compatible browser and reopen it offline after first load.

openQuestions: Replace placeholder Instagram and YouTube profile URLs with the owner's actual channels if desired.
